d:
Phool Jahan Bahar Wahan from Naya Kadam (1984) is a delightful romantic track sung by the legendary duo Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle. Featuring Rajesh Khanna and Sridevi, this melodious song captures the joy and charm of Bollywood romance in the 80s, making it an evergreen classic.

Song : Phool Jahan Jahan Bahar Wahan
Movie : Naya Kadam (1984)
Star Cast : Rajesh Khanna, Sridevi
Singers : Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle
Music Director : Bappi Lahiri
Lyricist : Indeevar
